parsed.name: I²C主控制器
parsed.description: 这是一种I²C总线主控接口模块，用于在实验系统中与各类I²C从设备进行通信。它通常用于向外设写入配置数据、读取寄存器或采集数字数据，适合实验平台中的传感器、存储器及其他低速数字器件联机控制与测试。
parsed.description_en: This is an I2C bus master interface module used to communicate with I2C slave devices in laboratory systems. It is typically used to write configuration data to peripherals, read registers, or acquire digital data, and is suitable for controlling and testing sensors, memory devices, and other low-speed digital components in experimental setups.
